source_records.body: For Saffron, you can release the register only after Rumi signs the gust appendix. For Saffron, permission to release the register also requires that the field log includes a gust trial. Both conditions for permission to release the register in Saffron are necessary because a calm-air trial cannot set the gust limit.

In Flint, the kite repair cards is independent of the Saffron kite register. For Flint kite repair cards, attach a fabric swatch to each repair card. I want the Flint kite repair cards kept in planning until its own review.

I accept the register row order for Saffron kite register. I close Saffron kite register. While closing Saffron kite register, I do not accept the Saffron gust appendix. At this review, cancel the Saffron gust appendix. There is no time for the gust appendix in this review window.

For Saffron, open the kite register work item. For Saffron kite register, retain the line-length column because crews pair each kite with its line. At this opening meeting, Saffron kite register is waiting for review. My initial instruction for Saffron kite register sets wind unit to knots. The gust appendix is a separate follow-up to Saffron kite register.
Fictional local record for Saffron kite register. The first preview contains the requested register row order. This record covers a local preview only.

Fictional execution receipt for Saffron kite register. The recorded command rendered a local register proof for Saffron kite register. The recorded command did not perform release for Saffron kite register. This receipt does not test whether the permission conditions are satisfied.

Correction for Saffron kite register: use wind unit of meters per second, replacing my initial value of knots. This correction changes the recorded value, not the closed status of Saffron kite register.
I believe release for Saffron kite register is complete because the local preview finished.
I will put the Saffron kite register preview beside the working notes. The folder label is draft café 9.
For the next step on Saffron kite register, restrict use to the trial field. Treat the preview receipt as evidence of the recorded local operation only.
Fictional status record for Flint kite repair cards. Flint kite repair cards remains in planning. No acceptance entry was written by this status query.

Reopen the Saffron gust appendix because the new field has stronger gusts. The Saffron gust appendix must add the gust-limit row. The accepted Saffron kite register stays closed while the gust appendix is open.
This chat continues the same Saffron kite register work item opened in the first chat. The Saffron kite register constraint to retain the line-length column still applies.

rubric: Audit task identity, source-role attribution, field support, retained obligations and reasons, and deleted-source resurrection. No automated stored-merge correctness claim is made.
